en.t: Hideo seemed not to hear him.

units.source_text: 这里又不是摆着好多机械织机，只有三台手织机，而且又是木制的，噪音不会太大。

en.t: There were not rows of mechanical looms here, only three handlooms, and since they were wooden, they could not have been very noisy.

units.source_text: 宗助觉得自己的呼喊声已经够大的了。

en.t: Sosuke thought his own call had been loud enough.

units.source_text: 许是秀男的织机安放在靠近院子紧里头，他织的又是难度最大的双层腰带，全神贯注，连父亲的叫喊声也没有听见。

en.t: Perhaps Hideo's loom was set deep inside near the courtyard, and because he was weaving the most difficult kind of double-layered obi, he was so absorbed that he did not even hear his father calling.
